name: Freeport-McMoRan
outlook:
What Freeport-McMoRan says to expect

  • Full year 2026: sales volumesConsolidated sales are expected to approximate 3.0 billion pounds of copper, 649 thousand ounces of gold and 93 million pounds of molybdenum for the year 2026, including 875 million pounds of copper, 300 thousand ounces of gold and 22 million pounds of molybdenum in fourth-quarter 2026.
  • Full year 2026: capital expendituresCapital expenditures are expected to approximate $4.4 billion, including $3.0 billion for major mining projects, for the year 2026.
  • Full year 2026: operating cash flowsFCX’s consolidated operating cash flows are expected to approximate $8.5 billion for the year 2026, net of $0.6 billion of working capital and other uses, based on current sales volume and cost estimates, and assuming prices of $6.50 per pound of copper, $4,000 per ounce of gold and $32.00 per pound of molybdenum in fourth-quarter 2026.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 27, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
